visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene is set on a bright television studio stage. A man in light blue denim overalls stands between two women; one in a black cropped top and dark pants, the other in a vibrant green sleeveless dress. They are gesturing energetically towards a screen that displays images of white, twisted snacks. (2) The editing cuts rapidly between close-ups of the participants and a full shot of the stage. A woman in a black top is seen shouting with her mouth wide open and hands raised in excitement. The snack on the screen changes to yellow, stick-like crackers. (3) The camera captures a woman in a red and white striped shirt talking intensely, then cuts back to the man and the woman in green. They are all engaged in a fast-paced guessing game, pointing at the on-screen images and reacting with big facial expressions under bright studio lights.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy studio environment with multiple overlapping female voices and one clear male voice speaking in Traditional Chinese. A steady electronic dance beat with a prominent kick drum drives the rhythm. The pitch is high and delivery is rapid-fire. (2) A sharp 'ding' sound effect interrupts the speech momentarily, followed by a burst of laughter and cheering from a background crowd. The voices become more strained and excited as they shout out snack names. (3) The dialogue continues at a fast pace with brief pauses between sentences. A woman's voice explains product features with high melodic variability. The BGM remains constant until the end, providing a high-arousal backdrop for the comedic interaction.
